findings.title: Reproduced Ref2VA workload
findings.text: Native generation took 124.421 s; export took 0.929 s. Exact reference prompt, trainer/trainee image hashes, seed 287987790, four steps, checkpoint, LoRA and runtime revisions were retained. This reproduces Larryvrh Ref2VA; it is not FastH3 V2.

findings.title: RAM sizing estimate: 96 GiB
findings.text: Process-tree RSS peaked at 52.37 GiB; PSS at 50.29 GiB; host used RAM at 57.37 GiB. The recommendation adds 32 GiB of margin to the measured whole-host peak and rounds up. It is an estimate from this larger host, not a validated memory limit.

findings.title: Measured GPU activity
findings.text: Kernel presence covers 108.922 s (86.89% of the measured window). Duration-weighted SM activity averages 85.18%; tensor activity 61.85%. Kernel presence, SM activity and occupancy are different quantities.

findings.title: Host-memory peak location
findings.text: Peak RSS sample occurred at 118.266 s. Containing host phases: node/VAEDecode. Sampled peaks can miss briefer excursions.

findings.title: Attention kernel cost
findings.text: Kernels classified as attention sum to 54.479 s across 14418 launches, or 50.02% of summed GPU kernel durations. Overlapping durations are not elapsed time or an achievable speedup estimate.

findings.title: Measurement scope
findings.text: One measured generation after a complete preparatory generation. Nsight overhead is included. CUDA/NVTX/OSRT capture and hardware counters cover the measured window; no CPU scheduling/backtrace samples were requested. Nested host phases are inclusive and must not be summed. Separate Nsight Compute replay is excluded from all main timing and memory statistics.

findings.title: Memory accounting
findings.text: RSS, PSS, private memory and whole-host used RAM are alternative views and must not be summed. File cache is partly reclaimable. The application tree includes telemetry and export subprocesses; external profiler memory is included in whole-host used RAM. Initial setup is outside the measured window.

findings.title: Telemetry cadence
findings.text: 1143 lightweight samples; median interval 0.100 s; maximum gap 0.296 s. RSS/device telemetry targets 100 ms; PSS/private memory targets 1 s. Distinct full-sample timestamps determine the plotted full-memory observations.

findings.title: Runtime and media verification
findings.text: Four reference-conditioned transformer forwards and 200 completed Sage CUDA attention calls were verified. No recorded Sage fallbacks, errors or competing GPU compute PID. Native and final outputs passed full FFmpeg video/audio decoding. Final output is 720×1280, 241 frames, 24 FPS, 32 kHz stereo. Dialogue accuracy and lip sync were not formally scored.

findings.title: Allocator scope
findings.text: PyTorch allocated/reserved peaks were reset before the measured run. They exclude external allocations. Device memory is sampled through NVML; no allocator timeline was collected or synthesized.

findings.title: RAM pressure and physical I/O
findings.text: Peak sampled process swap: 0.000 GiB. Application-tree physical reads increased by 37.82 GiB; parent major faults increased by 1,998. Host-wide swap-in/out changes were 4096 / 0 bytes; these are not attributed exclusively to the model.

findings.title: Clock and chart units
findings.text: GPC frequency is stored in Hz despite the SQLite MHz display label; the GB20x configuration multiplier 1e−6 converts it to MHz. Charts use 50 ms weighted means. Exact means, p95, peaks and coverage use raw intervals before binning. PCIe/DRAM hardware percentages are distinct from measured copy byte counts.

findings.title: CUDA transfer: Host-to-Device
findings.text: 62.494 GB across 5,978 copies; summed GPU copy duration 2.050 s; bytes divided by summed duration 30.492 GB/s. Copies may overlap compute or each other.

findings.title: CUDA transfer: Device-to-Host
findings.text: 2.848 GB across 87 copies; summed GPU copy duration 0.530 s; bytes divided by summed duration 5.372 GB/s. Copies may overlap compute or each other.

findings.title: CUDA transfer: Device-to-Device
findings.text: 10.023 GB across 1,115 copies; summed GPU copy duration 0.011 s; bytes divided by summed duration 946.428 GB/s. Copies may overlap compute or each other.

findings.title: Reproduction agreement
findings.text: Fresh checkpoint and LoRA SHA-256 hashes match the reference. Decoded audio matches the reference exactly across all 314 frames. Video has 57 identical decoded frames out of 241 and FFmpeg SSIM 0.984699 against the reference export; it is not bit-identical. These checks describe reproduction agreement, not dialogue or identity quality.
